ubiquitousLanguage.definition: The named client company or individual entity that commissions Projects. Root of the portal organizational hierarchy; all Projects, InvoiceRecords, and Stakeholder memberships belong to a ClientOrganization.

A portal participant - either a staff member or a client Stakeholder - identified by email address. Wraps Django's built-in User to carry portal-specific attributes such as is_client and organization.

A UserProfile whose is_client attribute is True, representing a member of the client team who reviews Deliverables and authorizes Approvals. Semantically distinct from a staff UserProfile. Not a separate model - a role classification on UserProfile.
A scoped, time-bounded body of work commissioned by a ClientOrganization. Progresses through states defined by ProjectStatus. Contains Milestones, Messages, and InvoiceRecords.
Enumeration of valid Project lifecycle states. Values: DRAFT, ACTIVE, PENDING_APPROVAL, COMPLETE, ARCHIVED.
A named checkpoint within a Project with a target completion date. Groups related Deliverables into reviewable phases. Progresses through states defined by MilestoneStatus.
Enumeration of valid Milestone completion states. Values: PENDING (not yet started), IN_PROGRESS (work underway), COMPLETE (all Deliverables in the Milestone approved).
A concrete work product produced within a Milestone, submitted for Stakeholder review and formal Approval. Versioned through DeliverableVersion records each time a revision is submitted.

An immutable, versioned snapshot of a Deliverable's content created each time a new revision is submitted for review. Preserves the full review history. version_number is a monotonically increasing integer per Deliverable.
A formal, immutable decision record created when a Stakeholder accepts or rejects a specific DeliverableVersion. Carries ApprovalStatus and an optional reviewer comment.
Enumeration of valid Approval decision states. Values: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, REVISION_REQUESTED.
Metadata describing a file asset attached to a Deliverable or Message. Stores filename, storage path, MIME type, and file size. Does not contain binary data; binary data resides in object storage.
A named, ordered channel within a Project that groups related Messages by topic or Milestone. Provides context for asynchronous communication between portal participants.

A single communication from a portal participant addressed to a MessageThread within a Project. Contains the message body, sender reference, and creation timestamp. Messages are append-only; no editing or deletion.
A billing document issued to a ClientOrganization itemizing charges for Project work. Tracks payment lifecycle via InvoiceStatus. Carries due_date, amount, and line items.
Enumeration of valid InvoiceRecord payment states. Values: DRAFT (not yet sent), SENT (delivered to client), PAID (payment confirmed), OVERDUE (past due date without payment), CANCELLED (voided).
An immutable, append-only log entry capturing a significant domain action within the portal. Event type is expressed in past tense per DDD convention. Never updated or deleted after creation.
The bounded context itself - the secure, role-gated web application through which ClientOrganization Stakeholders collaborate with the service provider on Projects.

entities.name: ClientOrganization
invariants: name must not be blank
slug must be non-empty, URL-safe (alphanumeric and hyphens only), and unique across all ClientOrganization records
A ClientOrganization may not be the target of an InvoiceRecord unless it has at least one Stakeholder (UserProfile with is_client=True)
created_at is set once at construction and is immutable

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identity, assigned at construction via uuid4()

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the client company or individual

attributes.name: slug
attributes.description: URL-safe identifier used in portal routes; unique per portal instance

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp set at construction; immutable thereafter

entities.name: UserProfile
invariants: email must be a non-empty, syntactically valid email address
user_id must uniquely reference a Django User; no two UserProfiles may share the same user_id
If is_client is True, organization_id must not be null - a Stakeholder must belong to a ClientOrganization
A staff UserProfile (is_client=False) must have organization_id set to null

attributes.name: is_client
attributes.description: True if this UserProfile is a Stakeholder; False for staff

attributes.name: organization_id

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp set at construction; immutable thereafter

entities.name: Project
invariants: name must not be blank
organization_id must reference an existing ClientOrganization and is immutable after creation
status must follow valid ProjectStatus transitions; direct field mutation from outside the entity is prohibited
target_date, when set, must be a date in the future relative to created_at

stateTransitions.guard: Project has at least one Milestone with at least one Deliverable
At least one Approval on the current review cycle is REJECTED or REVISION_REQUESTED
All Deliverables across all Milestones have an APPROVED Approval on their current DeliverableVersion

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: organization_id

attributes.name: created_at

target_date must be set before the Milestone can transition to IN_PROGRESS

All Deliverables within this Milestone have an APPROVED Approval on their current DeliverableVersion

attributes.name: name

attributes.description: References the parent Milestone; immutable

entities.name: Approval
invariants: deliverable_version_id must be set at construction and is immutable; an Approval is permanently bound to one DeliverableVersion
reviewer_id must reference a UserProfile with is_client=True (a Stakeholder); staff members may not create Approvals
At most one Approval may exist per DeliverableVersion; a second Approval for the same version is a domain violation
status is immutable once it reaches APPROVED, REJECTED, or REVISION_REQUESTED

stateTransitions.guard: Caller is a Stakeholder (reviewer_id references a UserProfile with is_client=True)
comment must not be blank; caller is a Stakeholder
comment must not be blank; caller is a Stakeholder

invariants: amount must be a positive Decimal value; zero and negative amounts are prohibited

Current date is strictly after due_date

attributes.name: id

attributes.name: organization_id

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: References the Project this invoice relates to; optional

attributes.name: status

entities.name: ActivityEvent
invariants: event_type must not be blank and must be expressed in past tense per DDD naming convention (e.g., ProjectStatusChanged, ApprovalDecisionRecorded)
occurred_at is set at construction to the current UTC time and is immutable thereafter
actor_id must reference an existing UserProfile
An ActivityEvent is immutable after creation; it is never updated or deleted

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identity, assigned at construction via uuid4()

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Past-tense name of the domain action recorded (e.g., ProjectStatusChanged)

attributes.name: actor_id
attributes.description: References the UserProfile whose action triggered this event

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: References the Project this event relates to; null for organization-level events

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: References the ClientOrganization this event relates to; null for project-scoped events

attributes.name: payload
attributes.description: Structured key-value data capturing the event details

attributes.name: occurred_at

valueObjects.name: Money
validationRules: currency must be a 3-letter alphabetic ISO 4217 code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

valueObjects.name: ProjectStatus
validationRules: Value must be one of: DRAFT, ACTIVE, PENDING_APPROVAL, COMPLETE, ARCHIVED; enforced by Python enum assignment

valueObjects.name: MilestoneStatus
validationRules: Value must be one of: PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE; enforced by Python enum assignment

valueObjects.name: ApprovalStatus
validationRules: Value must be one of: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, REVISION_REQUESTED; enforced by Python enum assignment

valueObjects.name: InvoiceStatus
validationRules: Value must be one of: DRAFT, SENT, PAID, OVERDUE, CANCELLED; enforced by Python enum assignment

valueObjects.name: StakeholderRole
validationRules: Value must be one of: CLIENT, STAFF, ADMIN; enforced by Python enum assignment

valueObjects.name: FileMetadata
validationRules: size_bytes must be a positive integer (> 0)

valueObjects.name: VersionNumber
validationRules: value must be a positive integer (>= 1); zero and negative values are prohibited

aggregates.name: ClientOrganizationAggregate
invariants: name must not be blank
slug must be non-empty, URL-safe (alphanumeric and hyphens only), and unique across all ClientOrganization records
created_at is set once at construction and is immutable

aggregates.name: UserProfileAggregate
invariants: email must be a non-empty, syntactically valid email address
user_id must uniquely reference a Django User; no two UserProfiles may share the same user_id
If is_client is True, organization_id must not be null
If is_client is False, organization_id must be null

aggregates.name: ProjectAggregate
invariants: Project.name must not be blank
Project.organization_id is immutable after creation
Project status must follow the defined ProjectStatus transition rules
Milestone.project_id is immutable and must equal the aggregate root's id
Milestone.target_date must be set before a Milestone can transition to IN_PROGRESS
Milestone status must follow the defined MilestoneStatus transition rules
All Milestones within the aggregate belong to the same Project root

aggregates.name: DeliverableAggregate
invariants: Deliverable.name must not be blank
Deliverable.milestone_id is immutable after creation
Deliverable.current_version_number increments monotonically with each submit_revision() call and never decrements
A new revision must not be submitted while the current DeliverableVersion has a PENDING Approval
At most one Approval may exist per DeliverableVersion
Approval.deliverable_version_id is immutable and must reference a DeliverableVersion that is a member of this aggregate
Approval.status is immutable once it reaches APPROVED, REJECTED, or REVISION_REQUESTED

aggregates.name: FileRecordAggregate
invariants: filename, storage_path, and mime_type must not be blank
storage_path is immutable after construction
file_size_bytes must be a positive integer
Exactly one of deliverable_version_id or message_id must be set

aggregates.name: MessageThreadAggregate
invariants: MessageThread.subject must not be blank
MessageThread.project_id is immutable after creation
Message.thread_id is immutable and must equal the aggregate root's id
Message.body must not be blank
Messages are append-only; no editing or deletion is permitted after creation

aggregates.name: InvoiceRecordAggregate
invariants: amount must be a positive Decimal value; zero and negative amounts are prohibited
organization_id is immutable after creation
due_date must be set before the InvoiceRecord can transition out of DRAFT
PAID and OVERDUE are terminal states; no further status transitions are permitted

aggregates.name: ActivityEventAggregate
invariants: event_type must not be blank and must be expressed in past tense
occurred_at is set at construction to the current UTC time and is immutable thereafter
An ActivityEvent is immutable after creation; it is never updated or deleted

Stakeholder UserProfile who requested the revision

payload.description: MIME type of the uploaded file
DeliverableVersion this file is attached to; None if a message attachment

domainEvents.name: MessagePosted
domainEvents.trigger: MessageThread.append_message() - a new Message appended to a MessageThread

payload.description: Related Project; None if not project-linked
Related Project; None if not project-linked
Related Project; None if not project-linked
Payment due date that was missed

payload.description: Related Project; None if not project-linked

domainServices.name: DeliverableApprovalCoordinator
domainServices.responsibility: When a Deliverable is approved, checks whether all Deliverables within the parent Milestone are now approved and, if so, triggers Milestone completion on the ProjectAggregate.

methods.name: coordinate_post_approval
methods.description: Inspects the current approval state of every Deliverable in milestone_deliverables; calls project.complete_milestone(deliverable.milestone_id) when every member has an APPROVED Approval on its current DeliverableVersion. Raises MilestoneCompletionNotAllowed if milestone_deliverables is empty.
